observations.summary: This feature resolves the duration, curve-level, curve-impulse and inflation evidence families. It does NOT resolve the credit axis. bond-regime-lab.html:1934 returns null from selectResearchExpression while EITHER axis is Indeterminate, and scripts/brief-refresh.mjs:1571 publishes state 'unavailable' when no preferred sleeve results. The credit axis needs an independent credit-spread family that bond-regime-universe.json:41-50 marks restricted-local-view and memory-only, which this spec must not change. scripts/selftest.mjs:5670-5682 already asserts the exact post-feature outcome: curves present and no spread observation leaves state 'unavailable' with durationPosture resolved and the gap list narrowed to the credit gap alone. Any certification that treats a resolved published bond verdict as this feature's success signal is measuring the wrong thing.

FR-018-019 has no committed source. data/calendars/xnys/calendar.json is an equity calendar and marks 2026-10-12 and 2026-11-11 as dateState 'regular' with closureCode null, while the US bond market is closed and Treasury publishes no curve on those dates. Reusing it unmodified would publish false staleness. Its coverageEnd is also 2026-12-31, so any freshness rule keyed to it inherits a coverage cliff. An authoritative, committable source for US bond-market publication dates must be chosen before FR-018-019 can be implemented.

rlcontracts.js:51-64 freezes SOURCE_IDS and SOURCE_POLICIES to five sources, none of which is home.treasury.gov. validateSourceProvenance at rlcontracts.js:515-560 rejects an unknown sourceId and an off-policy host or path. Carrying the repo's own source-provenance/v1 envelope on the published curve artifact therefore requires additive entries for us-treasury-nominal and us-treasury-real using the pathPrefix form, because the official path embeds the year. SOURCE_KINDS at rlcontracts.js:65-70 admits only four kinds, so the daily yield curve either reuses official-report or needs an additive kind. Whether the artifact carries that envelope at all is open question 2 in spec.md.

Every instrument characteristic in bond-regime-universe.json carries asOf 2026-07-10 with reviewWindowDays 45, expiring 2026-08-24. notes/bond-regime-lab.md:70 states stale characteristics make a sleeve Not rankable, and scripts/selftest.mjs:5630-5636 re-stamps them in its own fixture for that reason. This is outside this feature's scope and is a second, independent cause of an unresolved published bond read.
